verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents its own residential proxy network with country, state, and city-level targeting across 20+ countries, which covers the proxy half of the story. Its 'captcha-and-bot-bypass' docs describe automatic CAPTCHA solving, but that is an adjacent capability and nothing evidences stealth or browser-fingerprint controls. missing for 10: documented stealth/fingerprint-masking configuration, details on how proxies are enabled per run or session (API/SDK parameters), independent or hands-on corroboration that the proxies avoid bot blocking.
